subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Humane
solution:
The correct answer is “**merciless**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**Humane**" refers to showing compassion or benevolence towards others, especially in the context of the treatment of animals or people. (मानवीय) 

 
 
• **Example**- The dictator was known for his merciless regime, sparing no one who opposed him.
 
 
 
• '**Merciless**' This is the antonym of "humane" and refers to someone who shows no mercy or pity towards others. (निर्दयी) 
 
 
• **Example**- The doctor was renowned for his humane approach towards the treatment of his patients.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is ‘merciless’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Cordial**: Warm and friendly. (मित्रतापूर्ण)
 
• **Forgiving**: Ready and willing to forgive. (क्षमाशील)
 
• **Generous**: Willing to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
